name: New York workers' compensation claims by county and accident year
description: Workers' compensation claims assembled by the New York State Workers' Compensation Board in every New York county, for each accident year from 2000: the number of claims, how many have an attorney or representative (count and share), how many are controverted, how many have had a hearing and how many hearings were held, and how many are classified permanent partial or permanent total disability or occupational disease. Built only from SoQL aggregates of the Board's 5.7-million-claim file on NY Open Data (no claim-level row is read), with every count published from 11 claims up.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). New York workers' compensation claims by county and accident year (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23964068
keywords: New York workers compensation claims by county
workers compensation attorney representation rate New York

distribution.name: ny-workers-comp.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: ny-workers-comp.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: ny-workers-comp-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in ny-workers-comp-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to ny-workers-comp.csv on id.

recordSet.name: ny-workers-comp
recordSet.description: The records of New York workers' compensation claims by county and accident year, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id: dataset, place and period

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: NY for every record (the dataset is New York only)

field.name: level
field.description: county, state (all of New York) or unknown (claims with no county in the source)

field.name: accidentYear
field.description: Calendar year of the accident or disease onset (the claim's accident_date)

field.name: status
field.description: P: aggregated from the primary source

field.name: text
field.description: One plain sentence with the county's counts

field.name: claims
field.description: Claims the Board assembled with this injury county and accident year; published from 11 claims up

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: First day of the accident year

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: Last day of the accident year

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: Date the Board's file was last read

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
